overview: The Dominator Plus G3101 has long been the cornerstone of kitchens up and down the country, offering a level of performance, reliability and ease of use that other models strive to match. The new G3101HD delivers the next level of power and performance.

Six 6.9kW twin flame burners are 30% more powerful than on the G3101, delivering faster heat up times and more energy efficiency. There are three heavy duty cast iron pan supports that are robust and long lasting, as well as being shaped to ensure the burner flames are directed into the pot rather than escaping into the atmosphere. The hob is completed with removable drip trays under the burners that catch any spills and debris and can easily be taken out and washed in any size of sink.

The 7.1kW oven features a drop down door with a full width, robust handle which makes it easy to access the large 2/1 GN sized oven. This oven has five shelf positions, with two shelves supplied. Trays need to be placed on the oven shelf as the oven itself is the full width of the unit, making it wider than a standard 2/1 GN container. The oven is lit by way of a simple push button piezo ignition and has a temperature range of 120-270°C. The vitreous enameled finish makes it easy to clean and maintain.

The unit is finished with a high flue, which limits the chances of debris falling through the ventilation gaps, as well as guarding against excessive splashing on to wall of the kitchen. It is also supplied with castors at the back and adjustable legs at the front.

overview: The double waffle iron GED10 is equipped with two cast-iron moulds containing 2 imprints each for the cooking of 4 bruxelles waffles. 4 golden Belgian waffles are cooked at 230 °C in 3 minutes, 120 Bruxelles waffles per hour!

The cast-iron plates of this professional waffle iron are fixed. The power is sufficient under each plate, the waffle maker does not need to be turned over to finish the baking. Waffles are perfectly cooked without further manipulation of the appliance.
This waffle iron is especially intended for table service in tearooms and restaurants. It is also appreciated during animations for associations, festivals and fairs.
The GED10 is designed for pre-cooked frozen waffles, frozen pieces of dough and also for fresh, homemade waffles.

The plates of the electric double waffle maker are made of cast iron, the use of cast iron plates with a high conduction value makes it possible to spread the heat evenly and to obtain well gold and crispy waffles in just 3 minutes. This professional waffle iron is meant for intensive use. A patented stainless steel tray is placed around the bottom plate of the waffle iron- it recovers excess batter and makes cleaning very easy.

overview: The GED20 is ideal for the production of authentic Liege or Brussels style waffles, the GED20 Waffle Maker is ideal for using when mobile catering, restaurants, cafes or takeaways. With fast 10 minute heat up, the waffle machine is quickly ready to use. The dual cast iron cooking plates that allow up to four waffles to be cooked at a time. As the unit has independent temperature controls, you can scale the production when demand is high, whilst only operating one waffle iron during the quieter hours- saving energy and reducing running costs. The cabinet beneath the grill has plenty of room for accessories too! This, alongside your gas canister which can be secured with a strap, meaning that you don't have to worry when you move your Grill Guru on it's sturdy locking wheels.

The top of the hood is a double wall system, made with stainless steel, which stops it from getting too hot and keeping your hands safe. Same can be said for the grill tub which is made from enamelled aluminium, on top of being heat retentive it's super easy to clean.

overview: A superb addition to any professional kitchen, the Rowlett digital soup kettle is an innovative solution for heating, holding and serving up to ten litres of hot liquid foods. Thanks to its large capacity stainless steel inner pot, the Rowlett allows you to cook your food separately in the pot, and then transfer it directly into to the soup kettle for holding and service. This way, there's no need to change containers, so there's no loss of heat and less washing up. Whether you're using a gas hob, electric or induction, the inner pot is suitable for all hob types. As it's a dry heat soup kettle, the Rowlett doesn't use a water bath, and as such doesn't need filling or topping up - just select a temperature using the digital control panel and the Rowlett soup kettle reliably holds temperature for extended periods. The digital controls are user-friendly and accurate. The Rowlett soup kettle makes service easy. The hinged lid and ladle notch lets you easily access and serve the contents without fuss. And once you're all done, the whole unit is easy to clean.

overview: Stand out from the crowd with AS Terms Mosaic finish dome shaped pizza ovens, let your customers enjoy the pizza and the oven! Traditional gas ovens are a perfect modern alternative to the traditional wood fired ovens as you can regulate the temperature much easier resulting in higher productivity in addition the rotating base means the GR-K series are less labour intensive and you can get the same baking results for each pizza.
Rotating cooking base, giving a more uniformed performance, higher productivity & better working conditions are achieved as pizza peel with a shorter handle is used.
The heavy duty chamber is manufactured using refractory materials with a very high percentage of Aluminium Oxide (A12O3), which makes it extremely strong & wear resistant.
features: Rotation speed can be gradually increased & rotation direction can be reversed.
Heating up of the chamber uses an ecological burner with the use of NATURAL GAS or LPG & a recirculating fan.
The recirculating fan maintains optimum temperature of the oven floor & prevents it from getting cold.
Easily control the temperature by a digital controller.
The power of the burner can be changed by electronic modulator in the range of 5-100%.
The considerable thickness of insulation helps to achieve maximum economy.
The mosaic design is available in a range of colours, please see below colour options.

The zones also provide a smaller cooking area during quiet periods to be more economical or gives you more versatility when cooking two separate meals simultaneously, for example, cooking your burgers while keeping your veggies at optimum temperature.

This professional counter-top griddle is made with a 12mm thick machined steel plate, which provides even heat distribution and with this commercial kitchen appliance being thermostatically controlled, it gives accurate temperatures during the cooking process for consistent results.

As the Lincat Silverlink 600 Electric Griddle is useable on counter-tops, it means it is suitable for those cafes, small restaurants, kitchens or shops where space saving is vital and don’t have the capacity for a built in or free-standing griddle. The griddle is also ideal for those eateries that like to cook in front of house, allowing the customers to experience the smells and sounds of your cooking while they wait. The professional counter-top single electric griddle is robust, hard working and easy to use. This means it can also withstand the larger busy commercial kitchen environments such as large pubs and restaurants, large hospitals, school canteens, care homes and high volume production kitchens.

When it comes to cleaning, the plate is a flat surface so can easily be scraped and cleaned and as the plate is fully welded into the frame, it also prevent leaks and hygiene standards are improved as places where food and carbon can build up is reduced.
